The damaged synthetic cable section was replaced between 04:20:00 and 09:45:00, restoring normal auxiliary supply.

reference_summary: At 04:12:08 the corridor voltage sagged to 0.87 pu on the independent PT channel. The sag coincided with a 312 MW load step at the Synthetic feeder bus. SVC-11 reactive output reached its 148 Mvar ceiling within 4.2 s of the sag. The 148 Mvar ceiling was set by the thyristor firing-angle limit at 12 degrees. Controller-indicated reactive was 151 Mvar while the independent CT channel read 148 Mvar. Voltage recovery stalled at 0.91 pu for 11.6 s after SVC saturation. Corridor current peaked at 2,140 A on the independent CT channel at 04:12:22. Operator reduced the load step to 180 MW at 04:12:35 as a corrective action.

reference_summary: Synthetic station dispatched battery at 14:03:12 to shave 850 kW peak load. Peak shaver controller issued dispatch command at 14:04:05 without checking state of charge. Battery state of charge read 31.5% on the independent channel at dispatch time. Dispatch conflict arose because shaver and frequency regulator both demanded battery output. Frequency regulator held setpoint 59.9 Hz but shaver demanded 850 kW discharge. Inverter overcurrent protection tripped at 1,380 A after 42 seconds of conflict. Peak load of 1,420 kW returned to grid after battery trip at 14:07:24. Shaver controller firmware updated to check state of charge before dispatch at 15:30:00.

reference_summary: At 14:03:12 the Synthetic Meridian bus transfer sequence initiated under nominal 11kV busbar conditions with all tie breakers closed. Operators observed a maintenance-tag mismatch on the Synthetic Northgate feeder relay panel during the scheduled bus transfer window. A stale maintenance tag from a prior outage remained logged in the Synthetic Meridian tag register, conflicting with the active transfer permit. The tie breaker closed at 14:03:21, paralleling Synthetic Northgate and Synthetic Meridian sources for 4.7 seconds. Approximately 3.2MW of load on Synthetic Northgate was interrupted for 47 seconds before restoration via the alternate feed. Operators implemented a manual tag reconciliation procedure at 14:15:00 requiring dual verification before any transfer command.
